title: add downgrade guard + backup/restore + safe schema migrations for private installer
author: Marissa Chen
description:
This PR adds a downgrade guard and formalizes backup/restore and rollback tooling for the Private Installer (VPC/on-prem). Motivation: upgrades for on-prem customers can fail part-way (schema changes, operator errors, partial image downloads); we need a supported path to safely migrate and, if necessary, rollback. This change implements three coordinated features: (1) version pinning and downgrade-guard checks in the installer and helm charts to prevent accidental rollbacks that would leave DB schema incompatible, (2) a declarative backup/restore workflow (postgres + objectstore snapshots + etcd) integrated into the installer CLI and upgrade playbooks, and (3) transactional-safe schema migration runner with preflight checks and migration bail points. The description below outlines the behavior, upgrade/rollback playbook, and testing performed.

Behavior summary:
- Installer now writes a release metadata file to /etc/redwood-release (or configured path) containing pinned component versions and migration schema versions.
- Before applying an upgrade, a preflight backup is created (Postgres pg_dump, S3-compatible objectstore sync, etcd snapshot). Backups are verified (checksums + minimal integrity checks).
- Migrations are run via a safe runner that records each step in the DB (migration_version table). The runner supports a --dry-run and --bail-on-failure mode.
- On failure, operator can run `redwood-installer rollback --from-backup <backup-id>` which validates compatibility and restores services in the correct order.
- Downgrade is explicitly blocked unless a `--force-unsafe-downgrade` flag is supplied and manual intervention steps are followed (documented).

Files changed include installer CLI changes, helm chart updates (values and hooks), terraform module version pinning, and migration scripts. Linear references: ENG-5472 (upgrade safety), ENG-5588 (backup/restore documented flow).

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for migration runner and backup verification added.
- Integration tests run in CI against ephemeral k8s clusters: backup -> upgrade -> verify -> rollback -> verify.
- Manual runbook exercise performed against a staging customer cluster.

Follow-ups: add automated restore verification job for periodic e2e tests, expose backup retention policy via installer config (ENG-5721).
